brief: The weekly review framework every founder needs (and most skip).

slots.headline: The Weekly Review Framework Every Founder Needs (And Most Skip)
slots.author: FounderOS

slots.title: Clear Your Inboxes
slots.body: Gather every loose thread from email, Slack, and notes into one trusted inbox. Brain clarity starts with capturing it all. Don't judge yet, just collect.
slots.author: FounderOS

slots.title: Score Your Week
slots.body: Look back at your calendar and to-do list. What actually moved the needle? Mark wins and gaps honestly so you learn instead of repeat.
slots.author: FounderOS

slots.title: Triage Open Items
slots.body: Run each task through a simple filter: delete, delegate, defer, or do. If it takes under two minutes, handle it now and clear the noise.
slots.author: FounderOS

slots.title: Align to Goals
slots.body: Check your monthly objectives and quarterly targets. Are your upcoming priorities actually aligned or just busy work? Adjust before the week starts.
slots.author: FounderOS

slots.title: Map Next Week
slots.body: Block time for deep work, meetings, and buffer zones. Assign each big rock to a specific day so you begin Monday with intent, not chaos.
slots.author: FounderOS

slots.title: Close the Loop
slots.body: Journal one lesson, one gratitude, and one intention. This five-minute ritual seals the week and protects your mindset going forward.
slots.author: FounderOS

slots.headline: Run Your Review This Sunday
slots.body: Save this framework and block 30 minutes this weekend. Your future self will thank you.
slots.author: FounderOS
